summary: Verified effect badge visibility fix in ProductCard.js. Badge now renders as dark (rgb(0,0,0)) text on white (rgb(255,255,255)) background on both Home and Shop pages. Confirmed via computed styles across 5 product cards on each page, product images render correctly, and no layout breakage was observed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ProductCard effect badge fix (text-black on bg-white) is confirmed on both Home and /shop pages. 14 product cards on each page. Age gate testid: age-gate-yes. Product card testid pattern: product-card-<slug>.
rca of the issue: Previous bug: badge span had bg-white but inherited white text color from parent theme, making the text invisible. Fix: explicit `text-black` Tailwind class added to the badge span in /app/frontend/src/components/ProductCard.js line 22. Verified computed color is rgb(0,0,0) against rgb(255,255,255) background — high contrast, fully legible.
